## `neuro.number.toPrecision`

Instance method on `Number.prototype`.

> Returns a string containing a number represented either in exponential or fixed-point notation with a specified number of digits.

## Signatures

```ts
toPrecision(input: { number: <receiver>; precision?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Number.prototype.toPrecision` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
